discovery.method: JDK 25 Class-File API over locally resolved JARs
discovery.note: Counts include packet variants and extension methods/fields.

environment.mapping: none; Minecraft 26.3 ships unobfuscated and Loom uses no-remap

limitations: Direct invocations only; this is not a transitive call graph.
Method fingerprints are SHA-256 of the raw Code attribute plus method descriptor; they are conservative review triggers, not constant-pool-normalized digests.
Clientbound packet semantics are not classified here; they require human review.
Extension-point signatures are parsed from the resolved Fabric JARs; runtime registrations (mod payloads/receivers) are not present in this environment.
No modded block/item/entity implementations are enumerated.
